notes.title: Misao - 2024 HD Remaster Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26245179/72cf31a1db9355778adf1d35b7614444c574c8bf.png

Mad Father developer sen's other horror classic Misao: Definitive Edition was released 7 years ago in October 2017, and today, it has been reborn again into Misao - 2024 HD REmaster!

Misao - 2024 HD Remaster doesn't only add HD graphics and update the overall presentation, but also adds new features that make exploring stages all the more enjoyable, giving the game a new playfeel.

If you've already witnessed all the horrors of Misao, get the update now to see a newly reborn Misao.

...Did you know that Misao has a surprising thing in common with Mad Father, despite the difference in setting. If you haven't yet, why not try to find the link?

Owners of Mad Father can get Misao - 2024 HD Remaster in the Blood-Soaked Bundle for 10% off!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/5052/

notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Mad Father.

The updates for Ver 3.08 are as follows:

Option settings will now preserve changes even after closing and reopening the game. This change also means that all changes made to option settings will be shared among different save files. (All settings on all save files will be reset to default upon first launch after installing this update)

Thank you, and enjoy Mad Father!

notes.title: Mad Father Remake update coming this Halloween season!
notes.notes:
Mad Father has been remade and is better than ever. 

In this remake, not only have the graphics been updated, but there are new events in game and an added new game plus dubbed ""BLOOD Mode"" where the story changes dramatically. Discover the untold history between the blonde boy, Dio, and the Drevis family. 

In the new Blood mode the player will control a brand new main character and uncover the cursed past of the Drevis family.

The update is planned for around Halloween this year, so keep your eyes peeled!

Remake Trailer:
[previewyoutube=kByFaZ0e2cQ;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Steam Sale! Celebrating the release of The Crooked Man!
notes.notes:
Today we have released "The Crooked Man" developed by Uri Games, the first installment in "The Strange Man" series. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/736570/The_Crooked_Man/

We are also planning to release the other titles in this series. 

To celebrate the launch of this title, we have set some fantastic 2D pixel games from Playism on sale! So please enjoy them all together. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/483980/Mad_Father/

In addition, we would like to introduce the impressions from Sen, the developer of Mad Father, about The Strange Man series.  

I have played Uri-san’s works going back as far as Paranoiac. The event scripting and narrative framework in each and every title has been exemplary. The atmosphere, so peculiar to this series, immerses you in these worlds the same way a good movie does.
All games in the Strange Man series are fully-fleshed out horror experiences in their own right, but fans of suspense and mystery will find much to like here, too.
The game’s difficulty level has been tuned to provide a satisfying challenge without undermining its intended experience in frustration.


We hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Misao: Definitive Edition Released! 10/25 Bug Fix Update!
notes.notes:
Today we have released Misao: Definitive Edition on Steam!
Just three months ago, a young girl went missing. Her name is Misao. She was a classmate of the player's character.
Quiet and reclusive, this plain girl was often the target of bullies.
Since the day she disappeared, rumors spread throughout the school of unnatural phenomena. 
The children called it "Misao's curse"...
http://store.steampowered.com/app/691450/Misao_Definitive_Edition/

We have also updated Mad Father with bug fixes.

Update Contents 

  Fixed the issue where items that couldn't be interacted with still showed "!".
  Fixed the problem where the doll disappears unnaturally in Aya's room.
  Fixed the issue where you couldn't walk in some places in the bathroom. 
  Fixed the lighting problem in the corridor. 
  Fixed the text overflow in the love letter. (English Only)


We hope that you continue to enjoy Mad Father! 
http://store.steampowered.com/app/483980/Mad_Father/

notes.title: [10/11 Update ]Beta build updated for more testing (ver 3.03)
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Thanks so much for all of the support so far.
And sorry about the fact the crush issue is still there for most of the users.

We updated the beta build to ver 3.03.

Below is the list of updates:

Modified the Game.exe to ignore the font-related issues.
Game.exe should have more stability upon the start-up of the game.
Bug fix: Command action didn't display any keys and could escape from the attack
-> Directional keys seem to be the issue. Now it is shown with abcd keys.
Bug fix: The map chip of the pew where Ogre is sitting having wrong colour.
Font fix: new fonts implemented for the better visual.
Achievement re-enabled.


The pass for the beta build is same as the last one. I think I'll just keep using this for this testing.

PlayismMadFatherBeta1004

I'll edit the bug reporting thread after this news post.
We'll appreciate your help.

[10/11 Update]
Sorry guys, it seems I forgot to add the new font file in the depot.
Now the depot has minor update.
This might be the cause for someone having "no font" issues.
But it seems the crushing is still there..
We'll keep looking into it.

notes.title: Update:　Ver 3.01
notes.notes:

You can find the details of the update below: 

[Added]
- QUIT GAME option added in the title

[Fixed]
- Achievements now enabled
- Bug fix: Cannot proceed the game after the Snowball episode
- Bug fix: Aya's graphic glitch upon opening the asylum door on B3F
- Bug fix: Sometimes Aya can go beyond priest's ghost on the T-shaped aisle on B2F
- Bug fix: Aya's walking animation slowed down after picking up some item
- Bug fix: several map issues

We hope you keep enjoying the game.
